citations.claim: first in_arena violation: body 0 centre near right wall with high outward speed
body 0 speed ~30.6 m/s at violation, too fast for boundary to contain
body 0 was stationary before impact (step 26), so speed came from collision
one step later body 0 has vx~30.6 after being hit by fast heavy body 1

counterfactual.change: reduced body 1 initial vx from 27.7 to 10.0 only; lower impact speed means body 0 never reaches escape velocity and no in_arena violation in 33 steps

explanation: Fast heavy body 1 (vx~27.7) strikes stationary light body 0 around step 26-27, imparting vx~30.64 to body 0 (steps 26->27). Body 0 then travels ~3 m in 6 steps (~0.52 m/step) and its right edge penetrates 0.25 beyond x=20 at step 33. Boundary collision/positional correction fails to stop this high-speed body despite substepping (18 substeps), so it escapes the arena.
vision_note: Across steps 30 to 32 the blue and red circles sit near the top-right to the right of a vertical wall, drifting slowly rightward. At step 33 the red circle reaches the right boundary with roughly half its body outside the arena while the blue circle remains inside.
